name: Package pin
description: A package an instance or profile installs at a version or from a channel

fields.name: Target
fields.description: The instance's or profile's record id

fields.name: Source
fields.description: The first-party repository, the Ubuntu archive, or an approved third-party source

fields.name: Channel
fields.description: The channel, when no version is pinned

fields.name: Repository
fields.description: For a third-party pin: the apt source it installs from
